meta.title: the 2 minute rule changed my life
meta.creator: maya.rvrs

transcript: Hi guys so today I'm going to be talking about productivity. The two minute rule is something I read about in a book. Basically if something takes less than two minutes you should just do it. I tried it for a bit. I think it kind of worked sometimes. Let me know in the comments if you want more videos like this. Follow for part two. Bye.
